basic_info.description: Priced to SELL! ! !  Experience the ultimate San Francisco lifestyle in the heart of Mission Bay.  Bright light filled well laid out 2BR/2BA + office is located in one of San Francisco's fastest growing neighborhoods with open concept floor plan. One of the few 10' ceiling unit in the building.  Chef's kitchen features integrated cabinetry, luxury SS appliances and a large eat-in island, perfect for family to gather around while preparing a gourmet meal.  Kitchen seamlessly opens up to the large dining & living areas with floor to ceiling windows for entertaining.  Off the living room are the office/play area and the patio for working from home.  Spacious primary suite features double closet and a large bathroom with dual vanity.  Hidden in the hallway closet are the in unit washer/dryer.  Storage & parking conveniently located on the same level steps from the unit.  Amenities includes with on-site Property management, controlled door and elevator access, fitness center, club room, BBQ area and a 8,000 sq. ft. rooftop garden with gathering area and fire pit.   Steps from Chase Center, Oracle Park, restaurants, entertainment, waterfront trail and parks including a pet & children's park nearby.
